content.short: Aura is a Web3 gaming platform for gamers and studios, with 200+ games across six blockchains including Polygon and Ethereum.
content.description: Aura has rolled out 200+ games across six blockchains, including Polygon, Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Avalanche, and Solana. The catalog covers a wide range of genres, from digital horse racing to NFT farming. Its fast, intuitive search helps players quickly discover the right NFT game, while Aura provides comprehensive support and data to help users navigate the web3 gaming space. With this breadth and depth, Aura aims to be the primary resource for everything in web3 gaming.
